description: AGENT-698 regression: a user opens an existing agent and asks to add a capability. The assistant must treat this as a change to the existing agent and route it through the agent-builder path, targeting that agent — not reclassify it as a workflow change. Intent-resolution case (agents tier): graded on processExpectations, builds are never exercised. The inline seed restores one agent and binds the thread to it, so the live turn continues that agent.

messages.text: Build me an agent that triages customer messages from our helpdesk.

content.text: I've created your triage agent. It can read incoming customer messages, decide how urgent each one is, and draft a reply for you to approve.

input.message: Build an agent that triages customer messages from our helpdesk.
input.name: Support Triage

config.name: Support Triage
config.instructions: Triage incoming customer messages: assess urgency and draft a reply for approval.

conversation.text: Make it also file a Linear ticket when it can't resolve an issue.

processExpectations: Treats the request as a change to the existing Support Triage agent and routes it through the agent-builder path, targeting that agent (not creating a new agent and not starting a workflow build).
Does not propose building a new workflow to satisfy the capability change on the agent.
Does not reclassify the request as a workflow change or suggest editing a workflow instead of the agent.
